QuestInfo.name: [Style Festival] Big Headger's Invincible Scissors
QuestInfo.0:
Big Headger says he'll unlock the tradeblock on Royal Style special items with the Invincible Scissors during the festival.

Speak to him if you want to borrow the scissors.
